items.originalTitle: Alpine issues statement after Jeremy Clarkson's controversial Franco Colapinto comments
items.summaryEn: Alpine has publicly backed its driver Franco Colapinto after Jeremy Clarkson joked on Sky Sports F1's live broadcast that the driver had received a grid penalty "for being Argentinian".
detailZh: 阿尔派就杰里米·克拉克森涉弗兰科·科拉平托争议言论发表声明
在杰里米·克拉克森于电视直播中开玩笑称弗兰科·科拉平托因“是阿根廷人”而被罚退后，阿尔派公开表态支持这位车手
杰里米·克拉克森进入围场。
赛道之外的赛车文化。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计与那些让赛车超越运动本身的故事。
阿尔派 已发表声明，支持其车手弗朗哥·科拉平托，此前前《Top Gear》主持人杰里米·克拉克森在天空体育 F1 节目中开玩笑称，这位车手因“身为阿根廷人”而被处以发车位罚退。
克拉克森在美国大奖赛周末与恩斯通车队共度时光，多年来他一直支持这支家乡车队，并在排位赛前于美洲赛道现身天空体育 F1 的直播节目。
这位《克拉克森的农场》主持人讨论了多个话题，包括科拉平托的发车位罚退、马丁·布伦德尔的发车区巡游以及刘易斯·汉密尔顿的伴侣金·卡戴珊。
当被问及 阿尔派 在美国大奖赛的机会时，克拉克森开玩笑说：“弗朗哥因为身为阿根廷人而拿到了发车位罚退。大概吧。好吧，我会因为这个给他一个罚退。”
“但不管怎样，那只是因为我们当年去那里时发生的事情，”他补充道，指的是他连同联合主持人詹姆斯·梅和理查德·哈蒙德于2014年造访巴塔哥尼亚时那期最具争议的《Top Gear》节目。
抗议爆发后，三人逃离了该国，当时克拉克森驾驶一辆车牌号为H982 FKL的保时捷928，剧组遭到石块投掷，当地人认为该车牌是在影射1982年的马岛战争。克拉克森和《Top Gear》剧组坚称车牌纯属巧合，并否认是故意选择的。
克拉克森的言论发表后，阿尔派发布声明，支持科拉平托。
“我们阿尔派注意到一位车队客人在奥斯汀最近一次电视采访中所作的评论，”车队表示。“弗兰科是我们的车手，我们全力支持他。”
虽然声明中没有点名克拉克森，但紧随这位66岁人士的言论之后发布。
科拉平托因在2026赛季第四次接受新的控制电子单元，被处以本周末美国大奖赛正赛发车位后退10位的处罚。
detailEn: Alpine issues statement after Jeremy Clarkson's controversial Franco Colapinto comments
Alpine has publicly backed Franco Colapinto after Jeremy Clarkson joked on live TV that the driver had received a grid penalty "for being Argentinian"
Jeremy Clarkson enters the paddock.
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.

Alpine has released a statement in support of its driver Franco Colapinto after former Top Gear host Jeremy Clarkson joked on Sky Sports F1 that the driver had been given a grid penalty "for being Argentinian".

Clarkson is spending the United States Grand Prix weekend with the Enstone outfit, which he has supported for several years as his local team, and he appeared on the live Sky Sports F1 broadcast at the Circuit of the Americas ahead of qualifying.
The Clarkson's Farm presenter discussed several topics, including Colapinto's grid penalty, Martin Brundle's grid walk and Lewis Hamilton's partner, Kim Kardashian.
"Franco’s got a grid penalty for being Argentinian. Probably. Well, I’d give him one for that," Clarkson joked when asked about Alpine's chances at the United States Grand Prix.

"But anyway, that’s just because of what happened when we went there," he added, referencing one of the most controversial Top Gear episodes from when he, along with co-hosts James May and Richard Hammond, visited Patagonia in 2014.

The trio fled the country when protests broke out and the crew was pelted with stones after Clarkson drove a Porsche 928 carrying the number plate H982 FKL, which locals believed was a reference to the 1982 Falklands War. Clarkson and the Top Gear crew have insisted the number plate was a coincidence and have denied it was chosen on purpose.
Alpine released a statement following Clarkson's comments, backing Colapinto.
"We at Alpine are aware of the comments made by a team guest in a recent television interview in Austin," the team said. "Franco is our driver and has our full support."
While the statement does not name Clarkson, it closely followed the 66-year-old's comments.
Colapinto was handed a 10-place grid penalty for this weekend's United States Grand Prix for receiving his fourth new control electronics unit of the 2026 season.

items.originalTitle: George Russell calls for F1 rethink as cars are “forced to run so low and so stiff”
detailZh: 乔治·拉塞尔呼吁F1重新思考赛车行驶状态
乔治·拉塞尔认为Formula 1需要重新审视其车辆当前的行驶状态
对于梅赛德斯车迷来说，这里是关于银箭的最新消息，包括F1新闻、车手更新、赛车发展和比赛分析，来自布拉克利和布里克斯沃斯。
梅赛德斯F1车手乔治·拉塞尔明天将面临美国大奖赛的挑战，由于资格赛表现不佳，他将从第六位发车。尽管他的队友和车队领袖基米·安东内利将从杆位发车，但这位英国人认为，鉴于美洲赛车场上的颠簸问题，F1可能需要重新考虑车辆的行驶状态。
红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘在周四比赛周末之前首先提出了投诉，他描述这些颠簸为"无法接受"和"失控"。拉塞尔支持这位荷兰人，但随后在周六表现不佳后，他表示他认为汽车本身也是问题的一部分。
“是的，我的意思是这确实非常糟糕，”他在赛道表面上说。"但是当你被迫将汽车跑得如此低和如此僵硬时，这始终是一个挑战。如果我们能让它在赛道上行驶，那么我们可能需要考虑他们如何让我们在更合理的区域驾驶汽车。"
周四，拉塞尔呼吁一级方程式赛道每几年就重新铺设一次路面，他指出，在直道结束时，汽车离地面只有"10毫米"。
COTA主席博比·爱泼斯坦承认在1号弯的凹陷在他看来"无法接受"，但他告诉ESPN没有"简单的解决办法"。在排位赛中，麦凯轮车队的奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里将其比作"摩托车越野跳跃"，他在排位赛中排名第七。
梅赛德斯车手的周六并不顺利。他比安东内利慢了0.441秒，并表示他在Q3中根本没能完成一圈。
“我认为从我的角度来看，Q3中出了两个糟糕的圈。就是这样简单，你知道？在第一部分感觉很好。感觉不错，但后来低速时我挣扎了，Q3中根本没能调整好。”
他在第一次尝试中的失误代价高昂。
“只是在第12个转弯处打滑了一下，然后就像雪球一样滚开了。在第三部分失去了所有。就是这样。”
兰多·诺里斯称这是他感觉过的最糟糕的风，但拉塞尔说云层覆盖也产生了很大的影响。
“是的，我的意思是云层覆盖也有很大的影响，所以我认为在最后一圈没有人能有所改进，因为太阳出来了，但不幸的是，我的第一圈并不好。”
当被问及为什么云层会有如此大的影响时，他回答道：“嗯，对所有人来说，赛道温度上升了几个摄氏度，当你到达第三区时，这对轮胎和窗口或不是有很大的影响。”
第六名让拉塞尔还有工作要做。如果安东内利周日获胜，他就能锁定冠军，而拉塞尔排名第九或更低，刘易斯·汉密尔顿排名第五或更低。
detailEn: George Russell calls for F1 rethink as cars are “forced to run so low and so stiff”
George Russell believes Formula 1 needs to revisit how low and stiff its cars currently run
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.

Mercedes Formula 1 driver George Russell faces a challenging United States Grand Prix tomorrow as a disappointing qualifying means he'll start sixth. While his team-mate and championship leader Kimi Antonelli is starting on pole, the Briton argues that F1 may need to rethink how low and stiff the cars run following criticism of the bumps at the Circuit of the Americas.

Red Bull's Max Verstappen was the first to raise complaints on Thursday ahead of the race weekend, with him describing the bumps as "unacceptable" and "out of control". Russell backed the Dutchman, but, following his poor Saturday, added that he believes the cars are just as much a part of the problem.

“Yeah, I mean it is definitely pretty bad," he said on the track surface. "But it’s always a challenge when you’re forced to run the car so low and so stiff. If we can get it on the tracks, then maybe we need to think about how they allow us to run the cars in a more sensible region.”
On Thursday, Russell called for F1 circuits to be resurfaced “every couple of years”, pointing out that the cars run just “10mm” from the ground at the end of the straight.

COTA chairman Bobby Epstein has admitted the dip at Turn 1 is “not acceptable in my mind”, but told ESPN there is “no easy fix”. McLaren’s Oscar Piastri compared it to “a motocross jump” after qualifying saw him finish seventh.
The Mercedes driver's Saturday did not go to plan. He was 0.441 seconds off Antonelli, and said he simply failed to put a lap together in Q3.

“I think from my side, it was two bad laps in Q3. Simple as that really, you know? Was feeling very good in sector one. Feeling good, but then low speed I was struggling and just didn’t get it together in Q3.”
A mistake on his first run proved costly.
"It was just one slide around Turn 12 and then it was just a snowball. Lost it all in sector three. And yeah, simple as that.”
Lando Norris called the wind the worst he had felt, but Russell said cloud cover also made a big difference.
“Yeah, I mean cloud cover was having quite an impact as well, so I don’t think anybody improved on that last lap because the sun came out, but unfortunately my first lap was not good enough.”

Asked why the clouds made such a difference, he answered, “Well, just for everyone, the track temperature raises by a couple of degrees and when you get to sector three, that has a huge difference to the tyres and the window or not.”
Sixth leaves Russell with work to do. Antonelli can clinch the title on Sunday if he wins, with Russell finishing ninth or lower and Lewis Hamilton fifth or lower.

items.summaryZh: 安东内利获得2026赛季第七个杆位，自7月以来首次，他在美国大奖赛排位赛中击败了红牛车队的维斯塔潘和哈德贾。但由于全场三处处罚，发车顺序将与排位赛结果不同。
items.originalTitle: F1 2026 United States Grand Prix starting grid with three penalties
detailZh: 安东内利获得了2026赛季第七个杆位，这是他自7月以来的首次杆位，他在美国大奖赛排位赛中击败了红牛车队的维斯塔潘和哈德贾。
但由于全场三处处罚，发车顺序将与排位赛结果不同。
林德布拉德代表小红牛车队进入Q3，但由于他本赛季第六次更换内燃机，他将获得五处发车位处罚，但他仍能从第九位发车。
这意味着他将从第十四位发车。
弗朗哥·科拉平托，资格赛排名第14，因为今年第四次更换控制电子单元而受到10个位置的网格处罚。因此，阿尔皮纳车手将从第21位发车。
这是因为加布里埃尔·博托莱托被认为有80个位置的处罚，这是奥迪更换的各种发动机组件造成的。
以下是目前的状态的起跑网格：
*因动力单元组件更换的网格处罚
detailEn: It's a seventh pole position of the 2026 Formula 1 season for Kimi Antonelli, and a first since July, as he beat Red Bull duo Max Verstappen and Isack Hadjar in United States Grand Prix qualifying.
But the grid will be shuffled compared to the qualifying result due to three penalties throughout the field.

Arvid Lindblad made Q3 for Racing Bulls and was allowed to qualify ninth as the team opted not to run Liam Lawson, who'd also made the final part of qualifying, owing to a five-place grid penalty for Lindblad for taking a sixth internal combustion engine of the season.
That means he is due to start 14th.
Franco Colapinto, who qualified 14th, has a 10-place grid penalty for a fourth control electronics unit of the year. The Alpine driver is therefore due to start from 21st.
That's because Gabriel Bortoleto has what is believed to be a record 80-place penalty for the various engine components Audi has changed.

items.originalTitle: Kimi Antonelli delivers Austin surprise pole in tricky Mercedes: "Finally we're seeing the results"
items.summaryEn: Mercedes driver Kimi Antonelli took pole position for the United States Grand Prix at Austin, beating Red Bull's Max Verstappen and Isack Hadjar, with Ferrari fourth and fifth. He sees it as the reward for Mercedes' work to fine-tune its Malaysia upgrade package.
detailZh: 安东内利夺奥斯汀意外杆位，驾驶棘手的梅赛德斯赛车：“终于看到成果了”
安东内利自夏休期以来的首个杆位，是梅赛德斯更快但更难驾驭的F1赛车取得突破的标志
F1锦标赛领跑者安东内利认为，他在美国大奖赛拿下的杆位，是梅赛德斯努力调校其全面但棘手的马来西亚升级套件的回报。
安东内利在奥斯汀的美洲赛道挡住了红牛组合维斯塔潘和哈贾尔，而法拉利在周六排位赛的争夺中表现不及预期，仅列第四和第五。
在Q3中风势越来越大的情况下，把握住两轮排位赛中的第一轮变得至关重要。而在一个周末里，人们原本预期维斯塔潘与法拉利双雄勒克莱尔和汉密尔顿之间会展开较量，安东内利却多少带来了一丝惊喜，拿下了自七月比利时大奖赛以来的首个杆位。
这是对梅赛德斯努力发挥其马来西亚大奖赛重大升级套件效果的回报，该升级让W17更快，但也更难调校。这种挣扎看起来会在奥斯汀的第一节练习中延续，但车队逐步削减问题，改善了平衡。为奥斯汀带来的新前翼——曾在新加坡练习中试用——旨在进一步提升整套升级的效果。
“我很高兴，因为我们在这个套件上一直非常努力，而且我们仍在努力完全理解它，”安东内利在阻止维斯塔潘连续第三次夺得杆位后说道。
“自新加坡以来，我们又迈出了一大步，现在我们必须继续努力，继续理解。但这对车队来说是个好结果，因为他们在带来这个套件方面做了巨大的工作。终于，我们看到了成果。
安德烈亚·基米·安东内利，梅赛德斯，马克斯·维斯塔潘，红牛车队，伊萨克·哈贾尔，红牛车队
“这很令人意外，但今天对我来说最大的成就之一就是我没有超出赛道限制！这也让我们的处境稍微轻松了一些。我没有让自己陷入困难的局面，我们得以在整个阶段中逐步推进，并在此基础上继续提升。”
安东内利获得了第一个——尽管还很遥远——在周日锁定总冠军的机会，前提是他赢得比赛，而队友乔治·拉塞尔获得第九名或更低，并且汉密尔顿的排名不高于第五。
由于汉密尔顿和拉塞尔分别只从第五和第六位发车，安东内利在得克萨斯庆祝首个总冠军的机会可能仍然很小，但也并非可以忽略不计。
这位20岁的意大利车手表示：“我只想尽力跑好这场比赛。我会努力争取胜利，然后看看会发生什么。”
“感觉确实有些不同，但目标始终如一。我只需要继续做好自己的本职工作，而且实际上，我觉得自己更能享受驾驶和一切，因为我处于非常有利的位置。不过，心态始终是一样的。”
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli delivers Austin surprise pole in tricky Mercedes: "Finally we're seeing the results"
Kimi Antonelli's first pole since the summer break is a breakthrough for Mercedes' quicker but more difficult Formula 1 car
Formula 1 championship leader Kimi Antonelli reckons his United States Grand Prix pole is the reward for Mercedes' efforts to finetune its comprehensive but troubled Malaysia upgrade.
Antonelli held off Red Bull tandem Max Verstappen and Isack Hadjar on Austin's Circuit of the Americas as Ferrari flattered to deceive in Saturday's qualifying shootout by taking fourth and fifth.

With the gusty conditions only getting worse throughout Q3, nailing the first of two qualifying runs proved to be pivotal. And following a weekend that had been building up as a battle between Verstappen and Ferrari duo Charles Leclerc plus Lewis Hamilton, Antonelli sprung somewhat of a surprise by taking his first pole since July's Belgian Grand Prix.

It was a reward for Mercedes' efforts to exploit its big Malaysia upgrade, which has made the W17 faster but also more difficult to set up. That struggle looked set to continue in Austin's first practice session, but the team gradually chipped away to improve the balance. A new front wing for Austin, which was trialled in Singapore practice, was intended to further improve the package.
"I'm happy because we've been working really hard on this package, and we're still trying to understand it fully," said Antonelli, after denying Verstappen a third consecutive pole.

"Since Singapore, we've taken a big step further, and now we've just got to keep working on it, keep understanding. But it's a good result for the team because they've done a tremendous job on bringing this package. Finally, we're seeing the results.
Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes, Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing, Isack Hadjar, Red Bull Racing

"It was surprising, but also one of the biggest achievements for me today is that I didn't do track limits! That also made our life a little bit easier. I didn't put myself in a difficult situation, and we were able to just progress throughout the session and build from there."
Antonelli gets a first, if remote, opportunity to tie up the championship on Sunday if he wins the race and team-mate George Russell finishes ninth or lower, and Hamilton is no higher than fifth.
With Hamilton and Russell only starting fifth and sixth respectively, the chances of Antonelli celebrating a maiden title in Texas may still be small, but they are not negligible either.
"I'm just going to try to do the best race I can. I'm going to try to win, and then we'll see what happens," said the 20-year-old Italian.

"It does feel a little bit different, but the goal stays the same. I just need to keep doing my job, and actually, I feel like I can enjoy the driving and everything more because I'm in a very good position. But still, the mindset is always the same."

items.originalTitle: Why Ferrari failed to deliver on its hype in F1's United States GP qualifying
items.summaryEn: Ferrari topped all three practice sessions in Austin but could only manage fourth and fifth in qualifying with Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton, failing to find enough progression through Q3.
detailZh: 法拉利为何在美国站排位赛中未能兑现外界期待
尽管法拉利在奥斯汀三节练习赛中均居首，勒克莱尔和汉密尔顿最终仅获得第四和第五名
法拉利在美国大奖赛练习赛后曾被看作最具竞争力的车队，但排位赛最终表现不及预期，Q3未能找到足够的提升。
勒克莱尔在周五两节练习赛中均排名第一，汉密尔顿则在勒克莱尔最快圈被删除后拿下第三节练习赛（FP3）头名，看起来车队已准备好与红牛的马克斯·维斯塔潘争夺杆位。
随着本节练习的展开，梅赛德斯也加入了争夺；基米·安东内利随后在Q3中跑出一记强劲的首个飞驰圈，这一成绩足以力压维斯塔潘夺得杆位。勒克莱尔只能排在第四，汉密尔顿在周日正赛的发车格上位列第五，法拉利的速度在排位赛的关键阶段似乎陷入了停滞。
这背后有两条线索：法拉利的直线速度，以及它在排位赛最后阶段让轮胎达到足够准备状态的困难。
法拉利在低速弯中展现出强劲表现，并且在练习赛中也能在连续弯段末端的6号至10号弯之间，以及高速的16号至19号弯中找到时间。但随着排位赛节奏不断攀升，法拉利未能及时作出回应。
勒克莱尔认为，法拉利在Q3末段表现平淡的部分原因在于赛道温度的变化。法拉利底盘在正赛状态下能够将轮胎温度维持在相对较低的水平，但代价是排位赛单圈速度——因为要让轮胎达到合适的热度变得困难得多。当赛道温度下降时，找到正确的轮胎工作窗口就更加困难了。
“这非常令人失望，因为我认为还有其他一些比赛周末我们在自由练习中表现强劲，但到了排位赛就很明显，其他人在直道上就是有更多优势，我们很难与之匹敌，”这位摩纳哥车手解释道。
“我觉得今天是一场排位赛，我们车里有潜力，但赛车也包括轮胎，不幸的是在Q3我们不在正确的位置上。Q3时温度大概低了一两度，对我来说差别巨大；我在出场圈就真的很挣扎，从出场圈开始就打滑得相当厉害，这让之后变得非常困难。
“[这个瓶颈]是有原因的，所以同时我认为我们只需要更加努力，尝试比现在更好地理解那些轮胎。我认为其他人通常有更多一点余量，他们在Q3中提取圈速比我们更容易，而我们一旦稍微超出窗口，就会付出很大代价，所以这是我们需要研究的事情。
“我们的车不知为何，很难让那些轮胎升温，这在周日对我们来说是好事，但在排位赛中当赛道温度下降时，这让事情变得非常棘手。”
另一方面，汉密尔顿没有遇到和勒克莱尔相同的问题；相反，他觉得自己的出场圈“非常好”，为轮胎做好了准备，并且在本节练习的最后一次飞驰圈中跑得相对干净。
相反，他推测这仅仅是法拉利如何运行其动力单元的问题——部分是由于整体功率，部分是由于电气系统的功率切断。
“我还没有看数据，”汉密尔顿说，“但整个周末我们知道看直道，就像直到1号弯[相比]马克斯，当我们切断功率时，他们就是继续拉。在其他地方也类似，比如进入11号弯。
“我想我们在12号弯以及本圈剩余部分可能差不多。你在叠加图上能看到。我不知道发生了什么，我的车感觉真的很好。圈速很扎实，所以他们就是更快。”
“我认为[动力单元]是我们唯一落后的地方。我觉得我们的赛车非常扎实：至少和其他人一样好，也许还稍好一些，但我认为他们在底盘方面已经追赶上来了。”
“我们已经看到红牛在空气下压力方面追了上来。梅赛德斯至少从几场比赛前就带来了三成（0.3秒）的升级幅度。我认为他们开始弄清楚如何利用这一点了。”
“他们现在在弯道中与我们不相上下，而我们本赛季无法迈出那一步，在直道上弥补那部分速度。”
对于相对红牛-福特动力单元的这一动力总成差距，汉密尔顿给出了一个具体数字：他的评估是，练习赛的节奏表明在直道上大约有三到四成秒（0.3至0.4秒）的差距，而法拉利单靠弯道速度根本无法弥补这一点。
如果情况确实与轮胎有关，那么法拉利将有信心在大奖赛过程中管理好温度——但引擎动力，尤其是在漫长的后直道上，将更难弥补。
detailEn: Why Ferrari failed to deliver on its hype in F1's United States GP qualifying
Leclerc and Hamilton qualified fourth and fifth, despite Ferrari headlining all three F1 practice sessions at Austin

Ferrari had been pegged as the team to beat after practice at the United States Grand Prix, but ultimately found itself wanting when it came to qualifying and failed to find enough progression through Q3.

Charles Leclerc had headlined both Friday practice sessions, while Lewis Hamilton took the honours in FP3 after Leclerc's best lap was deleted, and it looked as though the team was primed to battle against Red Bull's Max Verstappen for pole position.

As the session unfolded, Mercedes entered the fray; Kimi Antonelli then reeled off a strong first effort in Q3 which proved good enough to clinch pole over Verstappen. Leclerc could only manage fourth, with Hamilton fifth on Sunday's Formula 1 grid as its pace appeared to plateau at the business end of qualifying.
There were two strands to this: Ferrari's straightline speed, and its difficulty in getting the tyres sufficiently prepared for the final part of qualifying.

The Ferrari demonstrated strong performance in the low-speed corners, and through practice had also been able to find time between Turns 6-10 at the end of the esses section, and through the high-speed Turns 16-19. But as the pace ratcheted up through the qualifying session, the Ferraris couldn't quite respond.

Leclerc reckons the source of Ferrari's flat end to Q3 was partly down to the change in track temperature. The Ferrari chassis manages to maintain reasonably cool tyre temperatures in race trim, but this comes at the expense of single-lap pace in qualifying as it becomes much harder to load them with the right level of heat. When the track dropped in temperature, it made the right tyre window more difficult to find.

"It's very disappointing because I think there are some other weekends where we've been strong in free practice, but then coming to quali it's very clear that the others are just having a lot more in the straights and it's very difficult for us to match that," the Monegasque explained.

"I feel like today it's a qualifying where we had the potential in the car, but the car also includes tyres and in Q3 unfortunately we were not in the right place. It was like one or two degrees less in Q3 and for me it was a huge difference; I just really struggled in the out-lap, I was sliding quite a lot already from the out-lap and that made it very difficult after that.

"There are reasons for [the plateau] and so at the same time I think we just need to work harder and try and understand those tyres even better than what we are doing now. The others I think normally have a bit more, it's a bit easier for them to extract the lap time in Q3 than it is for us and as soon as we are a tiny bit outside the window, we pay a lot the price, so this is something that we need to look into.
"Our car for some reason, it's very difficult to put some heat in those tyres which is a good thing for us on a Sunday, but in qualifying it makes it very tricky when the track temp goes down."

Hamilton, on the other hand, didn't experience the same issues as Leclerc; conversely, he felt that he'd had a "really good" out-lap to prepare the tyres and had enjoyed a relatively clean run with his final lap of the session.
Instead, he theorised that it was simply a matter of how Ferrari was running its power unit - partly due to overall power, and partly due to the cut-off in power from the electrical systems.

"I haven't looked at the data," said Hamilton, "but we know through the weekend we look at the straight, like just up to Turn 1 [compared to] Max, when we cut power they just keep pulling. That's similar in other places like going into Turn 11.
"I think we might be similar in maybe Turn 12 within the rest of the lap. You see it on the overlay. I don't know what happened, my car felt really good. Lap was solid, so they were just quicker.
"I think [power unit is] the only place we lose. I think our car is really solid: at least as good, maybe slightly better than the others, but I think they have closed up on chassis.
"We've seen the Red Bull closed up on their downforce. Mercedes took a three-tenths step of upgrade at least from a couple of races ago. I think they're starting to figure out how to utilise that.
"They're now matching us through the corners, we're not able to take that step in this season to close that speed on the straight."

Putting a number to that powertrain deficit to the Red Bull-Ford unit, Hamilton's assessment was that the practice pace suggested a swing of around three to four tenths of a second on the straights, and that Ferrari simply couldn't match up to that through its cornering speed alone.

If the situation is indeed tyre-related, then Ferrari will be confident that it can manage temperatures through the course of the grand prix - but engine power, especially on the lengthy back straight, will be harder to compensate for.

items.originalTitle: Isack Hadjar rues "disaster of a weekend" despite US GP qualifying turnaround
items.summaryEn: Isack Hadjar said Red Bull can use its two cars at the front to challenge polesitter Kimi Antonelli at the United States Grand Prix, after recovering from what he called a "disaster" start to the weekend.
detailZh: 哈贾尔称美国站周末开局灾难 排位赛仍实现逆转
哈贾尔表示，红牛将利用两辆赛车在前排的优势，在美国大奖赛上挑战安东内利
马克斯·维斯塔潘，红牛车队，伊萨克·哈贾尔，红牛车队
致红牛车迷。关注红牛车队，获取来自米尔顿凯恩斯的F1新闻、车手动态、技术洞察与比赛分析。
伊萨克·哈贾尔表示，红牛可以利用其数量优势，在美国大奖赛上击败杆位得主、当前领跑积分榜的基米·安东内利，此前他刚从周末“灾难性”的开局中恢复过来。
这位法国-阿尔及利亚车手最终仅落后队友马克斯·维斯塔潘0.036秒，在美洲赛道落后安东内利的杆位成绩0.215秒，并表示对赛车设置的大幅调整彻底改变了赛车。
哈贾尔将在发车格上排在第三位，位于安东内利和维斯塔潘之后，与法拉利的夏尔·勒克莱尔并列第四。
“对我来说，这个周末简直是一场灾难，”哈贾尔在排位赛后的新闻发布会上解释道。“我的圈速一直都被删除。今天早上，我在软胎上连一圈都没能完成。”
马克斯·维斯塔潘，红牛车队，伊萨克·哈贾尔，红牛车队
“我知道车里有些东西，因为有时候我能跑半圈并且感觉很舒服，但我始终无法完成整圈。但在那次排位赛中，赛车对我来说真的更有活力了一些。我们在调校上真的下了很大功夫。这个周末我们尝试了很多东西，而且真的得到了回报。
“所以，从这一点来说，真的非常非常令人满意。但我有点遗憾，不是太多关于最后一圈，而是更多关于Q3的第一次尝试，因为是的，最后一圈赛道状况更差，那不是一圈好圈，但每个人都是一样的。
“在第一圈，我真的觉得因为那巨大的顺风我损失了很多时间，我觉得今天还有更多潜力。但是的，我对这次回归感到高兴，可以说。”
当被问及他是否认为自己能在明天的大奖赛中挑战安东内利争夺胜利时，哈贾尔指出，拥有两辆红牛赛车分列第二和第三位是一种力量。
“是我们两个人，所以这算是一点优势。所以我们会尝试利用这一点，”哈贾尔说。
美国大奖赛将于10月25日星期日举行。
detailEn: Isack Hadjar rues "disaster of a weekend" despite US GP qualifying turnaround
Isack Hadjar says Red Bull will use its two cars at the front to challenge Kimi Antonelli in the United States Grand Prix
Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing, Isack Hadjar, Red Bull Racing
For Red Bull fans. Keeping watch on Red Bull Racing, with F1 news, driver updates, technical insight and race analysis from Milton Keynes.

Isack Hadjar says Red Bull can try to use its numbers advantage to beat polesitter and current championship leader Kimi Antonelli at the United States Grand Prix, after recovering from a "disaster" start to the weekend.

The French-Algerian driver ended up just 0.036 seconds behind team-mate Max Verstappen and 0.215s off Antonelli's pole time at the Circuit of the Americas, and said a big push on set-up had transformed the car.
Hadjar will line up third on the starting grid behind Antonelli and Verstappen, and alongside Ferrari's Charles Leclerc in fourth.

"It's been a disaster of a weekend for me," Hadjar explained in the post-qualifying press conference. "I've had all my lap times deleted all the time. This morning, I could not complete a single lap on the soft tyres.
Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing, Isack Hadjar, Red Bull Racing

"I knew there was something in the car because there were times when I could do half a lap and I felt comfortable, but I could never finish it. But in that qualifying, the car really came alive a bit more for me. We really dug deep on the set-up. We tried so many things this weekend, and it really paid off.

"So, on that note, it's really, really satisfying. But I'm a bit gutted, not too much about the last lap, but more about the first attempt in Q3, because yes, the track was worse on that final lap and it wasn’t a great lap, but it was the same for everyone.
"On that first lap, I really felt like I lost so much time with that massive tailwind I got, and I felt like there was a bit more today. But yeah, I'm happy with the comeback, let's say."
When asked if he thinks he can challenge Antonelli for the win in the grand prix tomorrow, Hadjar pointed to the power of having two Red Bull cars in second and third.
"It's the two of us, so it's a bit of an advantage. So we'll try and use that," Hadjar said.
The United States Grand Prix will take place on Sunday 25 October.
